prompt:

Header text verbatim: "ett hem". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "home".
Scene: A small cosy home with a family sharing tea among books and plants.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "hem resembles home.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Vi har ett litet men varmt hem.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
Critical: sentence must read "Vi har ett litet men varmt hem." The word litet has five letters L I T E T. Render all five letters clearly.
